2026_03_CIN_PIT.headline: Cincinnati’s spacing offense runs into Pittsburgh’s pressure plan in an AFC North collision
2026_03_CIN_PIT.paragraph1: Cincinnati’s best route through Pittsburgh is to keep its passing game on schedule and prevent the Steelers’ front from turning the afternoon into a protection test. Pittsburgh can counter by compressing the pocket and forcing throws before deeper concepts develop. When the Steelers have the ball, Aaron Rodgers’ ability to identify pressure and distribute quickly matters against a Bengals defense that cannot afford to surrender easy explosives. Red-zone execution could separate two familiar divisional opponents.
2026_03_CIN_PIT.model_rationale: Cincinnati benefits when its passing game stays on schedule, while Pittsburgh’s clearest counter is pressure that forces quicker decisions and limits explosive routes downfield.
